title: Kathmandu Jazz Night
description: Lose yourself in an enchanting evening of world-class jazz performed by acclaimed local and international artists. Set against the breathtaking backdrop of Yalamaya Kendra, this is Kathmandu's premier jazz experience. Enjoy curated cocktails, artisan food stalls, and an unforgettable ambiance.

ticketTypes.name: VIP Lounge
ticketTypes.description: Dedicated lounge seating, welcome drink included

ticketTypes.name: Backstage Pass
ticketTypes.description: Meet & greet with artists, backstage access

title: Himalayan Trail Run 2026
description: Challenge yourself on one of the world's most stunning trail running courses winding through rhododendron forests and mountain ridgelines. The Himalayan Trail Run offers distances for all levels: 10K, 25K, and the ultimate 50K challenge. Professional timing, aid stations, and finisher medals for all participants.

title: Nepal Tech Summit 2026
description: Nepal's largest technology conference brings together innovators, entrepreneurs, engineers, and investors for two days of cutting-edge talks, workshops, and networking. Topics span AI/ML, fintech, agri-tech, open source, and the future of Nepal's digital economy. Keynotes from international speakers and local tech legends.

ticketTypes.name: Standard Pass
ticketTypes.description: Full 2-day access to all talks and expo

ticketTypes.name: VIP All-Access
ticketTypes.description: VIP lounge, speaker dinner, premium networking

title: Artisan Pottery & Craft Fair
description: Celebrate Nepal's rich artistic heritage at the annual Artisan Pottery and Craft Fair. Browse and purchase unique handmade ceramics, Thanka paintings, Dhaka fabric, metalwork, and wood carvings directly from Nepal's finest artisans. Live demonstrations, pottery workshops, and a gallery curated by the National Academy of Fine Arts.

title: StartupConnect Networking Evening
description: Join Kathmandu's most dynamic startup networking event. Meet founders, investors, mentors, and service providers in a relaxed setting designed to spark meaningful connections. Includes a startup pitch competition (register separately), panel Q&A with seasoned entrepreneurs, and a sponsored drinks reception.

title: Newari Food Festival
description: A mouth-watering celebration of Newari cuisine — one of Nepal's most beloved culinary traditions. Sample authentic Newari dishes from top restaurants and home chefs, attend cooking masterclasses, and learn the stories behind iconic dishes like Yomari, Bara, Chatamari, and Choila. Live traditional sarangi and flute music throughout the event.

ticketTypes.name: Masterclass Package
ticketTypes.description: 2-day pass + cooking masterclass with a head chef

title: Pokhara Electronic Music Festival
description: Set against the stunning Annapurna range reflecting on Phewa Lake, PEMF brings world-class electronic music artists for three nights of euphoric beats and unforgettable visuals. Spanning multiple stages — from deep house to techno to ambient — this is Nepal's premier outdoor electronic music experience.

ticketTypes.name: VIP Weekend
ticketTypes.description: VIP stage view, artist lounge, camping spot

title: Kathmandu Half Marathon
description: Lace up and run through Kathmandu's iconic streets in this popular half marathon event. The route takes runners past ancient temples, bustling markets, and scenic riverside paths. Both individual and team categories available. Professional timing, water stations, physiotherapy support, and finisher medals. Suitable for all fitness levels.

ticketTypes.name: Half Marathon (21K)
ticketTypes.description: Official half marathon distance with chip timing

title: Himalayan Investment Summit
description: Nepal's premier investment conference connecting global investors with high-growth opportunities across infrastructure, renewable energy, hospitality, and tech sectors. Featuring keynote addresses from government officials, one-on-one investor meetings, deal showcases, and policy roundtables shaping Nepal's economic future.

title: Street Photography Walk — Kathmandu
description: Explore the hidden stories of Kathmandu's ancient lanes, courtyards, and bazaars through the lens of your camera. Join award-winning photographer Sunil Pradhan for a guided 4-hour street photography walk, covering composition techniques, light reading, and ethical photography in public spaces. Suitable for all camera types.

title: Cheese & Wine Evening
description: An intimate evening of curated cheeses and imported wines in the heart of Patan. Expert sommeliers and cheesemongers guide you through tasting pairings from across Europe, with a special local yak cheese flight from Himalayan producers. Limited to 60 guests for an exclusive, personal experience.

ticketTypes.name: Tasting Evening
ticketTypes.description: Curated cheese & wine pairings for one guest

title: Indie Film Screening — Nepal Stories
description: A curated evening of short indie films from Nepal's emerging filmmakers. Six short films exploring contemporary Nepali life, identity, and urban stories — screened in an intimate open-air setting. Followed by a panel Q&A with directors and a cocktail mixer. This event supports the Next Wave Nepal Film Fund.

ticketTypes.name: Supporter Pass
ticketTypes.description: Admission + cocktail reception + donation to film fund
